IDENT.title: BIOSOARM: a bio-inspired self-organising architecture for manufacturing cyber-physical shopfloors

A_DEFINITION__agent_definition_verbatim.value: No explicit agent definition; entities described as fully decoupled autonomous entities (Resource, Part, Transport). Autonomy defined (Definition 1).
A_DEFINITION__agent_definition_verbatim.evidence_quote: both shopﬂoor components and product parts are individualized and extended into the virtual environment as fully decoupled autonomous entities

A_DEFINITION__agent_term_used.evidence_quote: the different entities are autonomous, self-contained and loosely linked to each other

A_DEFINITION__agent_entity_types.evidence_quote: The different constructs, particularly the Part (PT) and the two superclasses Resource (RS) and Transport System (TS) are detailed below.

B_ARCHITECTURE__has_knowledge_base.evidence_quote: Each particular resource therefore holds a set of templates

B_ARCHITECTURE__kb_representation.evidence_quote: a template is composed by the required PTs, a skill and the resulting PTs

B_ARCHITECTURE__decision_mechanism.evidence_quote: if there are several attracting RSs, the PT is drawn towards the most attractive one

B_ARCHITECTURE__decision_scalability_dis.evidence_quote: This gain highlights the robustness and the system’s ability to scale production.

B_ARCHITECTURE__implementation_platform.evidence_quote: developed in JAVA using the JADE platform

C_MEMORY__memory_historical.evidence_quote: the plugging procedure is basically reduced to the deﬁnition of the attraction radius and creation of template ﬁles

C_MEMORY__memory_historical_description.value: Resources hold templates, attraction radius, buffer counts of stored/incoming parts.
C_MEMORY__memory_historical_description.evidence_quote: the number of incoming and stored PTs of type type(PTp) (stoIncP)

C_MEMORY__memory_realtime.evidence_quote: it starts by checking with the upstream neighbour (it can be either a RS or TCS) with which RSs is it connected

C_MEMORY__memory_scope.evidence_quote: no architectural component is fully aware of the production sequences

C_MEMORY__memory_update_mechanism.evidence_quote: That information is then further propagated to its downstream neighbours.

C_MEMORY__memory_requirements_stated.evidence_quote: the need to self-contain all the relevant information concerning each individual within the cyber-physical component it-self

D_COMMUNICATION__comm_protocol.evidence_quote: based on FIPA ACLMessage Performative REQUEST and INFORM messages

D_COMMUNICATION__negotiation_mechanism.evidence_quote: RSs and PTs are loosely coupled and only interact indirectly with each other

D_COMMUNICATION__comm_topology.evidence_quote: supported through direct interaction message patterns

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__validation_level.evidence_quote: used a customized modular automation simulation environment that simulates a conveyor-based shopﬂoor

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__metrics_reported.evidence_quote: done through the analysis of the system makespan in relation to the minimum makespan boundary

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__baseline_compared_.evidence_quote: For this purposed a scheduling tool named LEKIN was used.

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__disruption_types_h.evidence_quote: a new product (FP4) is randomly introduced during runtime

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__application_domain.evidence_quote: an “assembly line” that simulates the production of a car

IEC 61499 function blocks

I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__features_common_wi.evidence_quote: BIOSOARM is a class III control architecture. In this sense, there is no notion of master and slave among RSs, PTs or TSs.

I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__features_divergent.value: No workflows/plans: production flows emerge from firefly-inspired attraction via templates rather than product-driven planning and negotiation.
I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__features_divergent.evidence_quote: in BIOSOARM there is no need to deﬁne workﬂows, since the are no entities that need to be fully aware of the processing sequences

I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__essential_componen.value: Redundancy is necessary for self-organisation to make sense.
I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__essential_componen.evidence_quote: self-organisation only makes sense in the presence of redundancy

I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__static_vs_dynamic_.evidence_quote: once a CS is plugged the back-propagation mechanism is triggered and all the conveyor system self-organises
